technique_name: Classify the following article as either a myth or fact.
description: Fact. The average lifespan of a hamster is three to four years. Most hamsters reach sexual maturity at the age of 4-5 months, and their longest life expectancy is 2-3 years in captivity. Thus, their average lifespan is three to four years.
example: The average lifespan of a hamster is three to four years.
